The previously declared remote q2-q4-rerank head was A/B-measured against the pinned head on this tree (frontier 0863b06: segmented verify, EMA cost-model schedule, cap 7) and lost on both legs of the same-session comparison: accepted_draft_rate 0.964 vs 1.000 at 64 tokens (gated iterate) and 0.940 vs 1.000 at 128 tokens on an identical golden, with the pinned arm also faster on the candidate leg. Mechanism: the pinned path proposes through the runtime compact affine-4 copy of the target lm_head and selects by exact-row argmax; the declared head replaces that with a 2-bit coarse shortlist whose top-32 rerank can miss the true argmax, and each miss costs a full verify row against a dense readout it saves only ~0.6 ms per draft step. At the shipped schedule's mean draft length (~5-6), proposal quality dominates readout savings.
